draft_key_information_units.information: Net sales increased by 12.5% to EUR 17.8 million in 2025, the first double-digit growth since the consolidation phase.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Net sales amounted to EUR 17 756 thousand (EUR 15 782 thousand in 2024), representing an increase of 12.5 percent. Full-year revenues grew 12.5% to EUR 17.8 million — the first year of double-digit growth since the consolidation phase started.

draft_key_information_units.information: EBITDA reached EUR 1.828 million at 10.3% margin; net earnings after tax increased 42% to EUR 862 thousand at 4.8% margin.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: EBITDA of EUR 1 828 thousand (EUR 1 702) and EBITDA margin of 10.3 percent (10.8). Net earnings after tax of EUR 862 thousand (EUR 605), an increase of 42% and EAT margin of 4.8 percent (3.8).

draft_key_information_units.information: Equity improved to EUR 2.1 million and net cash position reached positive EUR 0.3 million by end-2025.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Equity has improved by EUR 4.6 million from -EUR 2.5 million in 2021 to EUR 2.1 million in 2025. Net Cash has improved by EUR 6.0 million, from -EUR 5.7 million in 2021 to reaching a positive position of EUR 0.3 million by the end of 2025.

draft_key_information_units.information: Ended the multi-year restructuring phase and transitioned to organic growth.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: In 2025, Talkpool ended its multi-year “reduce to the MAX” focus and started to grow. Ending restructuring phase and starting organic growth.

draft_key_information_units.information: Launched Vision 2030 Strategic Growth Plan in April with targets of 16.8% CAGR, 14.0% EBITDA margin, and zero net debt by 2030.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Launch of ”Vision 2030” Strategic Growth Plan in April, setting long-term financial targets including 16.8% CAGR (average annual revenue growth), 14.0% EBITDA margin, and zero net debt by 2030.

draft_key_information_units.information: Re-entered the U.S. market via MasTec contract in May and announced Nokia USA 5G EME/MEP testing partnership in November.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Re-entry into the U.S. market through a new service contract with MasTec in May. Partnership with Nokia USA on a 5G EME/MEP testing project announced in November.

draft_key_information_units.information: Launched Talkpool AB in Sweden in June to deliver advanced communication solutions for the defence sector.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: New Swedish Affiliated Company Talkpool AB launched in June to deliver advanced communication solutions for the defence sector.

draft_key_information_units.information: Supported Digicel in restoring Jamaica’s communications infrastructure following Hurricane Melissa.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Talkpool supported Digicel in restoring Jamaica’s communications infrastructure following Hurricane Melissa.

draft_key_information_units.information: Independent BDO valuation assessed the German subsidiary at approximately EUR 20.5 million.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Independent valuation by BDO put the market value of Talkpool’s German subsidiary at approximately EUR 20.5 million.

draft_key_information_units.information: Accelerated ramp-up of remote services and conducted trials of AI-powered technology solutions with commercialization planned for 2027–2028.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Talkpool has accelerated the ramp-up of its remote services. The first AI-powered technology solutions underwent trials and proof-of-concept testing during 2025. ... most promising solutions moving towards commercialization in 2027–2028 and mass deployment from 2029.

evaluation.selection_rationale: Units selected to prioritize headline 2025 financial performance and YoY changes, balance-sheet strengthening, the explicit strategic shift from restructuring to organic growth, the new long-term Vision 2030 plan, and major operational/market developments (US re-entry, Sweden defence launch, Digicel support, German valuation, remote/AI initiatives). Each represents a distinct, independently omittable material theme directly supported by the source, aligned with prioritization criteria for financial results, drivers, liquidity, and strategic events while excluding boilerplate and avoiding duplication or over-granularity.
